xir_repair.old_result: SPIR-V validation failure caused by post-merge selection re-entry

readonly_callable_abi_repair.invariant: the validated kernel argument layout is a module-wide ABI and must be frozen before post-order emission of any callable or kernel
readonly_callable_abi_repair.root_cause: direct-buffer metadata offset was initialized inside kernel emission even though outlined callees are emitted first and may load offset, size, or address metadata

readonly_callable_abi_repair.repair: compute and validate one SpirvKernelArgumentLayoutPlan before function emission, publish its metadata offset once, and assert the sole kernel consumes the same plan

regression.name: vk_user_compute_outlined_readonly_buffer_uses_frozen_kernel_argument_layout
regression.red_result: callable read metadata from word zero and produced incorrect subview indexing

material_isolation.invariant: all variants retain 350 geometries, 7543 instances, world data, and images; only material programs and slots are reduced
material_isolation.conclusion: nonlinear host-side IR expansion was isolated to whole-scene attribute metadata being recorded as shader branches; the original column-marble graph now renders through a cardinality-bounded device lookup

attribute_lookup_repair.invariant: for a fixed shader program and fixed number of attribute lookup operations, recorded AST/XIR control-flow size is independent of scene attribute-binding cardinality

rejected_hypothesis.name: sampled-table cardinality
rejected_hypothesis.method: reduce the Color Ramp, both RGB Curves, or all three tables from 257 samples to two while retaining graph topology
rejected_hypothesis.result: all-table-reduced variant remained at 45900 blocks, 1543437 instructions, and 15266 raw conditionals

attribute_lookup_repair.old_representation: one host-recorded Luisa conditional per whole-scene attribute binding in every attribute-using callable
attribute_lookup_repair.new_representation: one device binding table plus one compact range per geometry, searched by one dynamic loop over only the current geometry
attribute_lookup_repair.loop_exit: found state in the loop predicate; no nested cross-construct break
